name: x-automation
description: Desktop workspace for managing X accounts, drafts, scheduling and automation.
author: AxoraWeb

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/prepare-engine.mjs --platform=win && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/prepare-engine.mjs --platform=linux && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/prepare-engine.mjs --platform=mac --arch=arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: node scripts/prepare-engine.mjs --platform=mac --arch=x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/prepare-engine.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:release && npm run engine:test
